import java.util.*;

public class Main {

    // FlowBase generic class
    static class FlowBase<CapT, CostT> {
        static class Edge<CapT, CostT> {
            int src, dst;
            CapT cap;
            CostT cost;
            Edge<CapT, CostT> rev;
            Edge(int s, int d, CapT c, CostT co, Edge<CapT, CostT> r) {
                src = s; dst = d; cap = c; cost = co; rev = r;
            }
        }

        ArrayList<LinkedList<Edge<CapT, CostT>>> adj;

        FlowBase(int n) {
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new LinkedList<>());
        }

        // copy constructor - deep copy
        FlowBase(FlowBase<CapT, CostT> other) {
            int n = other.size();
            adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new LinkedList<>());
            for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                for (Edge<CapT, CostT> e : other.adj.get(u)) {
                    if (e.src == u) {
                        // original forward edge
                        Edge<CapT, CostT> newF = new Edge<>(e.src, e.dst, e.cap, e.cost, null);
                        Edge<CapT, CostT> newB = new Edge<>(e.dst, e.src, e.rev.cap, e.rev.cost, newF);
                        newF.rev = newB;
                        adj.get(u).add(newF);
                        adj.get(e.dst).add(newB);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        FlowBase<CapT, CostT> assign(FlowBase<CapT, CostT> other) {
            if (this != other) {
                FlowBase<CapT, CostT> cop = new FlowBase<>(other);
                this.adj = cop.adj;
            }
            return this;
        }

        int size() { return adj.size(); }

        LinkedList<Edge<CapT, CostT>> get(int node) { return adj.get(node); }

        void addEdge(int src, int dst, CapT cap, CostT cost) {
            if (src >= size() || dst >= size()) throw new IndexOutOfBoundsException();
            if (cap instanceof Integer && (Integer) cap <= 0) return;
            if (cap instanceof Long && (Long) cap <= 0) return;
            Edge<CapT, CostT> f = new Edge<>(src, dst, cap, cost, null);
            Edge<CapT, CostT> b = new Edge<>(dst, src, null, null, f);
            // reverse cap = 0, reverse cost = -cost (for numeric types we need explicit cast)
            // But we don't know CapT/CostT at runtime; we'll assume zero and negation works via method.
            // We'll handle mincostflow separately.
            f.rev = b;
            adj.get(src).add(f);
            adj.get(dst).add(b);
        }
    }

    static class MinCostFlow extends FlowBase<Integer, Long> {
        long minCost, totalCost;
        long[] supp;
        long[] ptnl;
        long[] dist;
        Edge<Integer, Long>[] last;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        MinCostFlow(int n) {
            super(n + 2);  // n original + source + sink
            minCost = 0;
            totalCost = 0;
            supp = new long[n + 2];
            ptnl = new long[n + 2];
            dist = new long[n + 2];
            last = new Edge[n + 2];
        }

        // copy constructor
        MinCostFlow(MinCostFlow other) {
            super(other);
            this.minCost = other.minCost;
            this.totalCost = other.totalCost;
            this.supp = other.supp.clone();
            this.ptnl = other.ptnl.clone();
            // dist and last are reinitialized each solve
            this.dist = new long[other.size()];
            this.last = new Edge[other.size()];
        }

        // Return size of original network (excluding source/sink)
        int sizeOrig() { return super.size() - 2; }

        void addEdge(int src, int dst, int cap, long cost) {
            if (src == dst || cap <= 0) return;
            if (cost < 0) {
                supp[src] -= cap;
                supp[dst] += cap;
                minCost += cap * cost;
                totalCost -= cap * cost;
                // add reverse edge with positive cost
                // Note: super.addEdge will create forward/reverse but we'll overwrite reverse cap/cost
                // Since super.addEdge sets reverse cap=null, we need to handle specially.
                // Instead we directly add edges.
                Edge<Integer, Long> f = new Edge<>(src, dst, cap, cost, null);
                Edge<Integer, Long> b = new Edge<>(dst, src, 0, -cost, f);
                f.rev = b;
                super.adj.get(src).add(f);
                super.adj.get(dst).add(b);
            } else {
                totalCost += cap * cost;
                Edge<Integer, Long> f = new Edge<>(src, dst, cap, cost, null);
                Edge<Integer, Long> b = new Edge<>(dst, src, 0, -cost, f);
                f.rev = b;
                super.adj.get(src).add(f);
                super.adj.get(dst).add(b);
            }
        }

        void supply(int node, int vol) { supp[node] += vol; }

        boolean solve() {
            int n = super.size();
            if (n <= 1) return false;
            int S = n - 2;
            int T = n - 1;
            long flow = 0;
            long suppSum = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                suppSum += supp[i];
                if (supp[i] > 0) {
                    flow += supp[i];
                    addEdge(S, i, (int) supp[i], 0);
                } else if (supp[i] < 0) {
                    addEdge(i, T, (int) -supp[i], 0);
                }
                supp[i] = 0;
            }
            if (suppSum != 0) return false;

            while (flow > 0) {
                if (!dijkstra(S, T)) return false;
                long resid = flow;
                int cur = T;
                while (cur != S) {
                    resid = Math.min(resid, last[cur].cap);
                    cur = last[cur].src;
                }
                flow -= resid;
                minCost += ptnl[T] * resid;
                cur = T;
                while (cur != S) {
                    last[cur].cap -= (int) resid;
                    last[cur].rev.cap += (int) resid;
                    cur = last[cur].src;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        long optimal() {
            solve();
            return minCost;
        }

        private boolean dijkstra(int src, int dst) {
            final long INF = totalCost + 1;
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            dist[src] = 0;
            PriorityQueue<Pair<Long, Integer>> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(
                (a, b) -> Long.compare(a.first, b.first)
            );
            pq.add(new Pair<>(0L, src));
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                Pair<Long, Integer> top = pq.poll();
                long curDist = top.first;
                int v = top.second;
                if (curDist != dist[v]) continue;
                ptnl[v] += curDist;
                dist[v] = -1; // mark invalid
                for (Edge<Integer, Long> e : super.adj.get(v)) {
                    if (e.cap == 0) continue;
                    int to = e.dst;
                    if (dist[to] == -1) continue;
                    long nd = ptnl[v] + e.cost - ptnl[to];
                    if (dist[to] > nd) {
                        dist[to] = nd;
                        last[to] = e;
                        pq.add(new Pair<>(nd, to));
                    }
                }
            }
            return dist[dst] != -1;
        }

        // simple Pair for priority queue
        static class Pair<U, V> {
            U first;
            V second;
            Pair(U f, V s) { first = f; second = s; }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        final int tlim = 105;
        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(6100);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int j = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            mcf.supply(j, 1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                int nu = u + n;
                int nv = v + n;
                for (int x = 0; x < k; x++) {
                    mcf.addEdge(u, nv, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                    mcf.addEdge(v, nu, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                }
                u = nu;
                v = nv;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                mcf.addEdge(n * t + i, n * (t + 1) + i, k, c);
            }
        }
        int dst = mcf.sizeOrig() - 1;
        mcf.supply(dst, -k);
        for (int t = 0; t <= tlim; t++) {
            mcf.addEdge(t * n, dst, k, 0);
        }
        System.out.println(mcf.optimal());
    }
}
